experience.playerFantasy: You arrive on a light-fantasy coast with no assigned destiny, take small jobs, travel by moonline train, and decide which adult strangers become friends, companions, rivals, or something more intimate.
experience.emotionalPromise: A relaxed, flirtatious sense of possibility: the world is larger than any romance, but attentive choices can turn an accidental meeting into a remembered relationship.
experience.commonKnowledgeBoundary: A readable contemporary-fantasy coast of trains, markets, vineyards, islands, inns, workshops and an adult academy; no lore glossary or specialist knowledge is required.
experience.openingObjective: Earn enough coin for a room before the last moonline train leaves Lantern Quay, while deciding whose invitation is worth following.

fixedRules: Every romanceable or intimate character is an explicitly established adult aged twenty-four or older.
Characters know only what they witnessed or were told; meetings, promises, boundaries, favors, debts and departures persist by stable character id.
Every recurring character owns one persistent visual identity record; once anchored, its task id and immutable traits cannot be silently replaced.
Travel between regions visibly passes through the Moonline carriage or station platform before the destination is committed.
Relationship changes cite a visible event and never use a hidden affection score as the sole truth.
generationRules: AI may create local adult NPCs, jobs, rumors, invitations, venues and minor routes consistent with the current region.
A generated NPC remains transient until a visible debut creates a stable character id and a visual identity anchor request.
Every turn changes location, knowledge, money, energy, reputation, an inventory fact, or a sourced relationship event.
Flirtation grows from attention, compatibility, consent and shared activity; never force intimacy, coercion, explicit sex or a single mandatory partner.
Failure produces fatigue, missed transport, lost coin, awkwardness, damaged trust or a changed route rather than deleting the save.

regions.rest: return to Lantern Quay inn after closing

choiceIntents: follow a person or deepen a relationship
explore a place or accept local work

signatureItem.ability: Carries three conductor stamps that can secure an otherwise unavailable late-night route or cabin.
signatureItem.limitOrCost: Each override permanently consumes one stamp, and the pass cannot create a route the player has never discovered.
signatureItem.provenance: Issued at Lantern Quay after the player accepts temporary work for the Moonline station.

threatPalette: the last moonline service is cancelled while the player is far from their room
a private invitation is repeated publicly and creates an unwanted rumor
sudden silver rain closes the vineyard road and separates companions
a night-market employer withholds payment after changing the agreed terms
